Subject: Request: provisional queue lock + provisioning checklist for Orbit AI late-stage close

Team —

Orbit AI (deal ORBIT-2027-03) is heading into final procurement next week. Legal has signaled an expected signature window by the end of next week, and they asked us to confirm a short runway for onboarding (initial dedicated pool for POC -> production ramp). Before we commit anything externally, I need a quick internal feasibility check and a temporary soft-lock on the nodes we intend to earmark.

Ask (short):
- Confirm available GPU slots that match a high-memory T4/LX-type slice for the two-week POC ramp (they expect ~120k inference tokens/day, model size approx 7B FP16, KV cache expected).
- Thermal/affinity constraints: any data-center/zone restrictions we should avoid?
- Ops: recommend a soft-lock window (how long can we hold without hard reservation?), and what signal do we need from Sales to escalate to a hard reservation?

I’ve cc’d the ops leads (Marcus) and capacity owner (Karthik). Please reply with a short status and attach the current node_inventory_snapshot if you can. If we can do a 72-hour soft-lock starting Monday 03/29, I’ll propose that to Orbit and align timelines.

Thanks,
Michael
Michael Grant
Head, Strategic Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference

Michael —

Quick readout: we have nominal capacity in the east-us pool to support an initial 7B FP16 instance set for a short ramp. Rough numbers: 12 nodes with sufficient VRAM and the right driver stacks currently idle this week, more constrained next week due to scheduled tests. Two immediate notes:

1) Soft-lock policy: we can apply a 72-hour soft-lock that prevents preemption for the targeted node set. It’s a metadata-only reservation (no billing impact) and requires ops acknowledgement. After 72 hours, it expires unless converted to a reserved commit via a formal capacity request (ops + finance sign-off).
2) Thermal affinity: the nodes in rack cluster eu-1b have elevated thermal load from other customers; avoid mapping for sustained 24/7 POC. Recommend east-us-a and east-us-c racks (affinity map attached by Marcus will confirm).

Next steps: Marcus — can you attach node_inventory_snapshot.csv and the thermal_affinity_map.pdf here? If ops can confirm a 72-hour soft-lock starting Monday 03/29 00:00 UTC, I’ll mark the pool as provisional and block it in the capacity board.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Capacity Planning
Redwood Inference
